items.docs:
This API allows user to update a reservation by fulfilling an upsell offer selected from the list of available upsell offers, based on the unique offer ID provided in the request body.

If an upsell offer group has `selectionType` set to `zero_to_one`, the user can choose only one offer under a specific `offerType` group. To process multiple offers, submit a API request for a `offer` selected

If an upsell offer group has `selectionType` set to `zero_to_many`, the user can choose multiple offers
